The team played its home games at [[Mizzou Arena]] in [[Columbia, Missouri]] as a ninth-year members of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. They finished the season 16-10, 8-8 in [[2020–21 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC Play]] to finish in 7th place. They defeated [[2020–21 Georgia Bulldogs basketball team|Georgia]] in the Second Round of the [[2021 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] before losing in the quarterfinals to [[2020–21 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team|Arkansas]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they lost in the First Round to [[2020–21 Oklahoma Sooners men's basketball team|Oklahoma]]. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Missouri Tigers men's basketball team|Tigers]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 15–16, 7–11 in [[2019–20 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish in a tie for 10th place with Arkansas.
